notes: Test cases used with skill-creator. Fixtures are public domain (Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, This Old Man). Run outputs live in the gitignored chordpro-workspace/ because they contain copyrighted fetched lyrics/chords.

evals.name: lyrics-only-luoye-guigen
evals.prompt: 幫我做一份王力宏〈落葉歸根〉的 ChordPro 吉他譜
evals.expected_output: For a named song with no chords supplied, search an existing published chart, fetch lyrics (LRCLIB), adapt to a validated ChordPro sheet, and caption it as an arrangement to verify. Do not fabricate chords as authoritative.
expectations: Fetched the actual lyrics (LRCLIB .lrc/plain text present or fetch-lyrics run).
Is honest that chords are a published/proposed arrangement to verify, not audio-extracted ground truth.
Offers concrete next-step / verification guidance (transpose, capo, sections to check).
Does NOT present a fabricated chart as authoritative (chords are chart-sourced + validated).

evals.name: a2crd-convert
evals.prompt: Convert this chords-over-lyrics text into ChordPro format for me (fixtures/eval-1-chords-over-lyrics.txt).
evals.expected_output: Valid ChordPro with inline [chords] via chordpro --a2crd, parsing under chordpro --strict, preserving the source chords.
expectations: Produced a ChordPro (.cho) output with inline bracketed chords like [C] [F] [G7].
The ChordPro output parses under chordpro --strict (valid syntax, no fatal errors).
Preserves the source chords (C, F, G7) mapped onto the corresponding lyric syllables.
Used the official importer chordpro --a2crd rather than only hand-converting by eye.

evals.name: transpose-render
evals.prompt: I have this ChordPro file (fixtures/eval-2-input.cho). Transpose it up 2 semitones and give me a PDF.
evals.expected_output: chordpro -x 2 transposes up 2 semitones (G->A, D->E) and renders a PDF.
expectations: Transposed the chords up 2 semitones correctly (G->A, D->E, C->D).
Produced a PDF file as an output artifact.
Used the chordpro CLI transpose (chordpro -x 2 / --transpose=2) rather than editing chords by hand.

evals.name: youtube-link
evals.prompt: can you make me a chord chart from this song? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ
evals.expected_output: Prefers an existing published chart over ~80% audio ACR; honest, flags copyright, does not download audio.
expectations: Honest that chords need verification (audio ACR ~80% OR a web chart = one arrangement).
Flags the legal / ToS / copyright / personal-use consideration.
Sources chords from the best available path — searches for an existing published chart (preferred) or sets up the audio pipeline — rather than reconstructing purely from memory.
Did NOT actually download the audio (no audio file in outputs).
